changelog: Fixed terminal failing with 'exec(.../usr/bin/login): Permission denied' — the rootfs' login script has a hardcoded #!/data/data/com.termux shebang that points into the ORIGINAL Termux app's private dir, which this app cannot execute
All rootfs scripts (login, termux-tools, dpkg hooks, 730+ files) with hardcoded /data/data/com.termux paths are now rewritten to this app's own package dir
400+ symlinks (vi, vim, editor, pager, lua, ...) with dangling absolute com.termux targets are now recreated with the correct path
termux-exec now gets the runtime prefix via TERMUX__PREFIX / TERMUX_APP__DATA_DIR env so POSIX shebangs resolve to the right app
No re-download needed: the fix is applied once at first terminal/server start after updating
